role: Metadata clarification only; no predictions, fitted parameters, folds or scores changed
clarification: The dictionary was fixed geometrically before this numerical fitting run, not before historical CFD labels were ever observed. The initial task already supplied historical q0 +/-X joint loads; every existing pose is development data. The original field name is too broad and must not be interpreted as label-blind preregistration.
actual_port_policy: All A/B/C normals and points came from the predetermined bbox formulas. No held-out labels selected normals, point locations or regularization; regularization was selected in inner training-only grouped CV.
b_pair_policy: One explicit parent-requested bounded development extension after reviewing ABC results; not a blind/preregistered model discovery. Only link2/link3 get a fixed pair along the longest bbox axis, with three coefficients per pair. No further candidates were searched.
independent_component_passivity: A modelling restriction, not a law imposed on each CFD wall component. All seven strict cases with positive link1 local power remain included; the measured whole-system power is negative for all strict cases.
scope_note: new_configuration/out_of_sample_configuration means the exact pose was not a training sample. It does not imply that the pose lies outside the geometric interpolation range. within_training_speed is recorded separately. No static candidate validates inertia or independent joint motion.
